plist.dict:
Label com.dori.herdr ProgramArguments
@HERDR_BIN@ server
WorkingDirectory @HOME@ EnvironmentVariables
PATH @PATH@ SHELL @SHELL@ LANG en_US.UTF-8 TERM xterm-256color
RunAtLoad <@RUN_AT_LOAD@/> KeepAlive
ThrottleInterval 30 StandardOutPath @HOME@/.dori/runner/herdr.log StandardErrorPath @HOME@/.dori/runner/herdr.log
